IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: THE POLICY & INNOVATION CENTER'S (PIC) MISSION IS TO UNLOCK THE REGION'S POTENTIAL BY CULTIVATING AND BUILDING PARTNERSHIPS. OUR NICHE IS TO ADDRESS INTRACTABLE ISSUES THAT CAN ONLY BE SOLVED WITH CROSS-SECTOR, MULTI-JURISDICTIONAL COLLABORATIONS. PIC DEVELOPS, TESTS, AND IMPLEMENTS WORLD-CLASS RESEARCH AND POLICY-DRIVEN SOLUTIONS TO SUPPORT CLIMATE RESILIENCE, CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE, AFFORDABLE HOUSING, QUALITY JOBS, AND BUILDING COMMUNITY WEALTH FOR DISINVESTED COMMUNITIES.

IRS990.Desc: SEE SCHEDULE O.USING RESEARCH AND DATA ANALYSIS, THE POLICY & INNOVATION CENTER PRODUCED REGIONAL PLANS, INFORMED THE COUNTY OF SAN DIEGO'S CLIMATE ACTION PLAN, AND DEVELOPED MUNICIPAL FINANCING AND HOUSING SOLUTIONS, ALSO, THE POLICY & INNOVATION CENTER IDENTIFIED LOCAL GAPS IN BACCALAUREATE DEGREES TO ASSIST A COMMUNITY COLLEGE DISTRICT TO OFFER FOUR-YEAR DEGREE PROGRAMS.

ProgSrvcAccomActy2Grp.Desc: SEE SCHEDULE O.APPLYING EQUITY FOCUSED RESEARCH TO OUR REGION'S MOST PRESSING CHALLENGES. FOUND SIGNIFICANT DISPARITIES IN EVERY DOMAIN AND DEMOGRAPHIC, BUT SOME OF THE STARKEST WERE RACIAL DISPARITIES IN EMPLOYMENT AND INCOME. COUNTINUED TO TRACK PROGRESS SAN DIEGO COUNTY YOUTH HAVE MADE DESPITE A VARIETY OF OBSTACLES FROM DISCRIMINATION TO HOMELESSNESS AND IDENTIFIED OPPORTUNITIES FOR TARGETED ASSISTANCE. EXAMINED DRIVERS ON WATER PRICES AND POTENTIAL FINANCIAL SOLUTIONS TO MITIGATE WATER POVERTY.

ProgSrvcAccomActy3Grp.Desc: SEE SCHEDULE O.APPLICATIONS, CONTRACT PROPOSALS AND RESEARCH LED TO AWARDS TOTALING OVER $15 MILLION TO THE REGION, ALONGSIDE CONTINUED GRANTS OF $4.5 MILLION.

ProgSrvcAccomActyOtherGrp.Desc: THE ORGANIZATION HAS BEEN:(1) BRINGING TOGETHER AND FOSTERING COLLABORATION AND CONSENSUS AMONG LOCAL GOVERNMENTAL BODIES, COMMUNITY LEADERS, RESEARCHERS, SUBJECT MATTER EXPERTS, AND STAKEHOLDERS FROM ACROSS THE REGION;(2) COLLECTING AND ANALYZING DATA AND CONDUCTING RIGOROUS ORIGINAL RESEARCH TO HELP EFFECTIVELY ADDRESS THE REGION'S PUBLIC INFRASTRUCTURE, HEALTH, HOUSING, ENVIRONMENTAL AND OTHER COMMUNITY NEEDS, AND MAKING THE RESULTS PUBLICLY AVAILABLE;(3) DEVELOPING AND HELPING IMPLEMENT INNOVATIVE STRATEGIES AND SOLUTIONS BASED ON THAT DATA RESEARCH;(4) HELPING LOCAL GOVERNMENTAL BODIES INCREASE FEDERAL GRANT FUNDING AND IDENTIFY AND OBTAIN OTHER FUNDING RESOURCES TO ADDRESS PUBLIC NEEDS ACROSS THE REGION; AND(5) SHARING THE RESEARCH, RESULTS, POLICIES AND INNOVATIONS NATIONALLY, TO BENEFIT THE PUBLIC IN OTHER REGIONS OF THE U.S.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: PIC IS EXEMPT FROM INCOME TAXES UNDER THE CURRENT PROVISIONS OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE (IRC) SECTION 501(C)(3) AND SECTION 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA FRANCHISE TAX CODE. ALL TAX-EXEMPT ENTITIES ARE SUBJECT TO REVIEW AND AUDIT BY FEDERAL, STATE, AND OTHER APPLICABLE AGENCIES. SUCH AGENCIES MAY REVIEW THE TAXABILITY OF UNRELATED BUSINESS INCOME OR THE QUALIFICATION OF THE TAX-EXEMPT ENTITY UNDER THE IRC AND APPLICABLE STATE STATUTES. PIC DOES NOT HAVE ANY MATERIAL UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS.

EXECUTIVE OFFICER COMPENSATION FOR THE CEO OF THE POLICY & INNOVATION CENTER WAS DETERMINED BASED ON THE ADVICE OF AN INDEPENDENT EXPERT COMPENSATION CONSULTANT AND IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE PROCESS TO QUALIFY UNDER FEDERAL TAX LAW FOR A REBUTTABLE PRESUMPTION THAT THE COMPENSATION IS REASONABLE. THE COMPENSATION REFLECTS THE AMOUNT PAID BY THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION TO ITS CHIEF INNOVATION OFFICER AND AN IN-KIND DONATION TO SUPPORT THE CEO POSITION AT THE POLICY & INNOVATION CENTER. OTHER COMPENSATION INCLUDES THE COMPENSATION PAID BY THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION FOR ITS CEO AND CFO, WHO ALSO SERVE AS NON-PAID DIRECTORS ON THE POLICY & INNOVATION CENTER'S BOARD.
NONDISCRETIONARY BONUS PAYMENTS WERE PAID BASED ON PERSONS MEETING GOALS SET BY AND APPROVED BY BOARD OF GOVERNORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 4
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION'S ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION WERE AMENDED APRIL 17, 2024 TO CHANGE ITS NAME FROM "SAN DIEGO REGIONAL POLICY AND INNOVATION CENTER" TO "POLICY & INNOVATION CENTER".

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 6
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION IS THE SOLE MEMBER OF THE ORGANIZATION. THE SOLE MEMBER MUST APPROVE THE ELECTION OF THE BOARD MEMBERS. IN ADDITION IT HAS OTHER RIGHTS UNDER CALIFORNIA NONPROFIT LAW AND AS CUSTOMARY FOR THE SOLE MEMBER OF A NONPROFIT, SUCH AS TO APPROVE AMENDMENTS TO THE ARTICLES OF INCORPORATION AND BYLAWS AND FUNDAMENTAL CHANGES SUCH AS A MERGER OR DISSOLUTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7A
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION, SOLE MEMBER, MUST APPROVE THE ELECTION AND REMOVAL OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION A, LINE 7B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION MUST APPROVE AMENDMENTS TO THE GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, MERGER, CONSOLIDATION AND JOINT VENTURE, SALE, LEASE, EXCHANGE, MORTGAGE, PLEDGE OR OTHER DISPOSITION OF ALL OR SUBSTANTIALLY ALL OF THE ASSETS OF THE CORPORATION AND DISSOLUTION.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FORM 990 IS REVIEWED BY MANAGEMENT AND THE AUDIT AND RISK COMMITTEES OF THE BOARD FOR ACCURACY AND COMPLETENESS. A COMPLETE COPY OF THE FINAL VERSION OF THE FORM 990 WAS PROVIDED TO THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS FOR THEIR REVIEW BEFORE THE RETURN WAS FILED WITH THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS DISTRIBUTED TO EACH BOARD MEMBER ANNUALLY, AND THEY ARE REQUIRED TO COMPLETE AND SIGN A CONFLICTS DISCLOSURE FORM ANNUALLY. BOARD MEMBERS ARE ALSO REQUIRED TO DISCLOSE ANY CONFLICTS AS THEY ARISE DURING THE YEAR. ANY DISCLOSED CONFLICTS ARE MANAGED IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, WHICH INCLUDES REQUIRING RECUSAL OF THE CONFLICTED DIRECTOR FROM THE DELIBERATION AND VOTE BY THE BOARD OR BOARD COMMITTEE AND APPROPRIATE DOCUMENTATION OF THE PROCESS, TO ENSURE THAT ANY CONFLICTS ARE MANAGED BY INDEPENDENT DIRECTORS IN THE ORGANIZATION'S BEST INTEREST. THE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY IS CONSISTENT WITH THE IRS' TEMPLATE CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY AND APPLICABLE STATE LAW.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE FINANCIAL STATEMENTS ARE AVAILABLE ON THE ORGANIZATION'S WEBSITE AND IN THE ANNUAL REPORT. THE ORGANIZATION'S GOVERNING DOCUMENTS AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY ARE AVAILABLE UPON REQUEST.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: PART V LINE 1A, 2A, AND PART VII, SECTION A:
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ALL WAGES, BENEFITS, PENSION CONTRIBUTIONS, AND PAYROLL TAXES ARE PAID BY THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION. THESE EXPENSES ARE REIMBURSED BY THE POLICY AND INNOVATION CENTER, UNDER A SHARED SERVICE AGREEMENT OR PROVIDED BY THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION IN-KIND. THE AMOUNT LISTED ON FORM 990, PART VII, SECTION A, REPRESENTS COMPENSATION PAID BY THE SAN DIEGO FOUNDATION TO ITS CHIEF INNOVATION OFFICER AND AN IN-KIND DONATION TO SUPPORT THE CEO POSITION AT THE POLICY & INNOVATION CENTER.
